title: Violation
description: A compliance violation object produced by the OPA `violations` set comprehension when a mandatory requirement in `input.assertions` is absent or false. Each violation is one element in the `violations` set returned by a Rego module's evaluation.

id.description: Requirement ID that was not satisfied. Matches `Requirement.id`.

directive.description: Directive label (e.g. DR0100-001). Copied from `directive.label` for traceability in aggregated violation reports.

section.description: Section title where the unmet requirement originated. Copied from `requirement.section_title`.

requirement.description: Full requirement text. Copied from `requirement.text` for human-readable violation reporting.
examples: All Departmental directives must be submitted electronically using the Directives Management System.

keyword.description: Mandatory keyword class that triggered the requirement extraction.

nist_families.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 control families applicable to the directive containing this requirement. Enables family-level gap analysis across the violation set.
